issues.body:
The doc (mod.rs:357) reads "The smallest numbered `family{k}_` prefix that no existing label starts with." The implementation is slightly more conservative than that in one corner: a label whose digit run has leading zeros parses to the same number as its canonical form, so it burns an index that is in fact still free.

Verified with an in-crate probe: `fresh_blank_prefix({"__sk00_x"}, "__sk")` returns `__sk1_`, even though no label starts with `__sk0_` (I asserted that in the probe). Under the documented wording the answer would be `__sk0_`.

This is harmless — the returned prefix is still provably fresh, which is the property the caller depends on, and erring toward a higher index can never cause a capture. It is purely a doc/implementation divergence that could mislead a later reader into thinking the returned index is minimal.

For the record, the other corner I probed is fine: a digit run that overflows `usize` (`__sk99999999999999999999999999_x`) is skipped and returns `__sk0_`, which is correct and fresh.
issues.fix_hint: Reword to something like "A numbered `family{k}_` prefix that no existing label starts with; `k` is the smallest index not claimed by a `family<digits>_` label (labels with leading zeros conservatively claim their numeric value)." No code change needed — the conservatism is the safe direction.
issues.title: fresh_blank_prefix doc says "smallest", but leading-zero labels make it skip a free index

issues.body:
Round 1 raised (as a minor, and explicitly as pre-existing rather than a regression) that `sk_prefix` is computed once at entry from the initial parsed document, so labels entering the fact set later — via `log:semantics` / `log:parsedAsN3` result formulae bound out through a variable, or via a nested `formula_closure` run computing its prefix only over its own formula — are outside the freshness proof.

The new comment at mod.rs:489-493 now states this scope limit explicitly and accurately: "Labels ingested later through document builtins or nested closure evaluation are outside this initial-source guarantee." That is the honest-disclosure half of the round-1 fix hint and is why this is a nit rather than a repeat minor — the code no longer implies a guarantee it does not provide.

I did not construct a triggering end-to-end counterexample this round either, so I am recording it as a documented residual, not a defect in this PR.
issues.fix_hint: Optional follow-up, not a change to this PR: file a bead for the ingest-side rename (apply the same rename-apart trick `stratum_blanks` already uses at the stratum boundary to blanks ingested through document builtins and nested closure runs), so the residual is tracked rather than only commented.
issues.title: Mid-run-ingested blank labels residual is now disclosed but not tracked by a bead

verdict.summary:
Both round-1 majors are fixed; I verified each by mutation, not by reading.

(1) Vacuous stratified test — stratum 2's source is now `_:__st0___sk0_1_e` with a corrected comment. Teeth restored: pinning `fresh_carry_prefix` to a constant `"__st0_"` (the exact bug it pins) now makes `stratified_carried_existential_survives_a_colliding_source_label` FAIL alongside its sibling; in round 1 that same mutation left it PASSING. The derivation matches: stratum 1 mints `__sk0_1_e`, stratum 2 sees it, `taken={0}`, carry prefix moves to `__st1_`.

(2) Quadratic scan — `fresh_blank_prefix` is now a single O(n) pass. Work-box measurement (NON-CANONICAL, order-of-magnitude only), adversarial `_:__sk{i}_x` minus benign `_:zz{i}_x` control, n=2k/4k/8k/16k/32k: PR head 2/4/2/13/20ms — flat. Reverting only that helper to the round-1 rescan loop gives 13/49/195/778/3179ms, delta quadrupling per doubling. Fix is real, probe is non-vacuous.

The rewrite is contract-preserving, not just faster: for any label starting with `family{k}_`, the digit run up to the first `_` parses back to exactly `k`, so that index is always taken. Non-numeric, empty and usize-overflow runs are skipped, and no such label can start with the returned canonical prefix. Corners resolve conservatively, never unsoundly.

The round-1 nit is fixed with independent teeth: a mutation keeping the minted node distinct while breaking co-reference across the two conclusion triples trips the new `parent_node == parent_object` assert specifically.

Full `cargo test -p sparq-reason` green (142 lib + all integration targets). Nothing in the repo pattern-matches the `__sk`/`__st` label shape, and the user-visible shape change is in CHANGELOG. Two nits remain; neither blocks. (Clippy not installed on this toolchain; CI gates it.)
